shops.name: Brass Uncle's Arms
shops.note: Honest prices, no credit. Names every gun. Has seen a real Inquisitor (the forged rosette fails here). Back room: bribe 200+, Intimidate DC 18; advantage on Persuasion for anyone proficient with heavy weapons or tinker's tools.

custom.name: "Margery" (mastercrafted laspistol)
custom.desc: Brass Uncle's own +1 laspistol. Never jams. Only for trusted customers.

shops.name: The Hacksaw Saint
shops.note: 10% off for a good fight story (Performance DC 12). Has seen a real Inquisitor. Back room: bribe 200+ (a shrine donation), Intimidate DC 18 (becomes a fist-fight); open to anyone with Vell's blessing. Repairs 10% of item price; +1 AC for a day 200.

custom.name: Saint's Second Skin
custom.desc: A +1 carapace chestplate engraved with prayers (AC 15 + Dex, max 2). Once per day, when you would drop to 0 HP, drop to 1 instead. Or trade Gitgrabba's banner for it.

custom.name: Armour repair
custom.desc: 10% of the armour's price: set the final price.

custom.name: Reinforce armour (+1 AC for a day)
custom.desc: Gristle beats extra plates on for the day.

shops.name: Saints & Sundries
shops.note: Bram hums three notes (Insight DC 14 or Antonio's telepathy). Back room = a crate under the altar: a bribe of any amount works. Anyone who buys from it is offered a hymn charm (Choir recruiting).

custom.name: Medicae (per Hit Die healed)
custom.desc: Set quantity = Hit Dice healed.

custom.name: Lesser Restoration
custom.desc: Ends one disease or condition (blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned).

custom.name: Remove Curse (Mother Sabine)
custom.desc: Only when Mother Sabine is in.

custom.name: Hymn charm
custom.desc: A brass charm etched with three musical notes. Bram presses it on back-room customers. (Choir recruiting token.)

shops.name: The Junk Tithe
shops.note: Back room: bribe 150+, or bring her something interesting from a wreck (counts as a favour). Intimidate DC 18: the servitors step in. Fits cybernetics for 10% of the part's price plus a long rest.

custom.name: Junk crate
custom.desc: Roll the Curios d20 (Give items → Enemy loot) and give the result.

custom.name: Cybernetic fitting
custom.desc: 10% of the part's price, plus a long rest to recover: set the final price.

shops.name: Gaunt-Ghhul's Memory Stall
shops.note: Shelf items for Thrones. Back-room items cost a memory, a secret or a promise of matching value (set the price to 0 and note what they paid). Minor memory: forget one detail. Major: lose a skill proficiency until bought back. Intimidate = he vanishes into his jars for the day.

custom.name: Memory jar: a preacher with a captain's bearing
custom.desc: A vision of Oriel, alive, preaching. Costs a major memory, or the hymn-book.

custom.name: Memory jar: a master duellist
custom.desc: Once: advantage on all melee attacks for 1 minute. Costs a minor memory.

custom.name: Memory jar: a hive cartographer
custom.desc: Once: you know the way out of any maze for 1 hour. Costs a minor memory.

shops.name: Wazbolt's Kustom Shop
shops.note: Owes the Ledgerers 3,000. Back room: win a fist-fight (Athletics contest) or bring Gitgrabba's say-so; bribes only in teef or shiny bits.

custom.name: Kustom job
custom.desc: One day. +1d4 damage on one gun and it gains Inaccurate. On a natural 1 to hit, roll d6: on a 1 it explodes for its own damage (DC 13 Dex half).

shops.name: The Gilded Grox
shops.note: Food, rooms and information. No blood on her floors.

custom.name: Room (per night)
custom.desc: A bed and a lock that mostly works.

custom.name: Good room (per night)
custom.desc: Bath, and a lock that works.

custom.name: Amasec (not watered)
custom.desc: You have to ask.

custom.name: A rumour (round for the table)
custom.desc: Roll d6 on the rumour table.

custom.name: A specific answer
custom.desc: 100–500, Ketta's call: set the final price.

custom.name: Back room for a private meeting
custom.desc: Where the Vell sit-down happens.

custom.name: Full repair (Dask's sabotage)
custom.desc: Or free via Wazbolt.

custom.name: Fake transponder codes
custom.desc: No questions. Back-room service.
